I also got bitten by `setQueryParameter`'s `setPage(0)`.
I used an init widget only to change the `highlight{Pre,Post}Tag` s and couldn't understand why it was failing.

In my case, I guess I could just fix it by using `instantsearch.js`'s `searchParams` instead, but it definitely is surprising.
